decisive_spans.text: Brain magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated T2 hyperintense lesions in the frontal, left parietal, and left occipital lobes with leptomeningeal enhancement

Emergent cerebral angiography revealed diffuse stenosis and a beaded pattern of the anterior and middle cerebral arteries and their branches, along with diffuse luminal narrowing and dysplastic changes in the right distal vertebral artery and basilar trunk, consistent with cerebral angiitis

response.rationale: D1 is strongly supported by multiple findings including specific MRI lesions and angiographic evidence of cerebral vasculitis, while D2 has less specific support. D3 and D4 are contradicted by negative antibody tests.
